newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland plans sugar beet quotas for farmers.
newsitem.headline: Poland plans sugar beet quotas for farmers.

text.p: Poland's agriculture ministry is working on a bill that would scrap the current sugar production quotas for refineries and introduce sugar beet production quotas for farmers instead, the farm minister said on Thursday.
"Our sugar bill needs to be changed. I have asked that it be amended so that sugar quotas are awarded to farmers," Jaroslaw Kalinowski told a news conference.

Under current regulations, the government sets an annual sugar production quota, which is 1.8 million tonnes this year, and the agriculture ministry divides it among the country's more than 70 refineries.
Kalinowski said that under his ministry's proposal sugar beet production quotas would be awarded by the elected self-governing farming chamber.
